cost_model: construction of every public coefficient is charged
line evaluation, local-series regularization, field inversion or equivalent ratio construction are charged
every quadratic character and sign multiplication is charged
enumerative discovery is not evaluator advice
curve_model: y^2=x^3+7 over prime fields with odd prime-order marked subgroup

line_templates.beta_convention: beta_lo and beta_hi are the two nontrivial roots of z^2+z+1 ordered by canonical integer representative
line_templates.constraint: a and b are not both zero

local_parameter.completeness: A nonzero affine line meets a smooth plane cubic with local intersection multiplicity at most three.
local_parameter.validity: Every tested nonzero subgroup point has y(P) != 0, so x is unramified and t is a uniformizer.

rational_atoms.admission: ord_P(L_num)=ord_P(L_den) at every tested subgroup point
rational_atoms.regular_value: ratio of first nonzero local-series coefficients after equal-order cancellation

sign_circuit.atom: quadratic_character of the regularized rational value

transfer_gate.claim_boundary: Failure closes only this line-ratio grammar through product weight four.
transfer_gate.discovery: the identical symbolic rational AST must equal parity on all five discovery curves
transfer_gate.holdout: an admitted candidate must run unchanged on all thirteen holdouts
